title: LG SIGNATURE — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for LG SIGNATURE.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Art of the Essential." Luxury tier. LG SIGNATURE is the ultra-luxury halo brand from LG — limited distribution, gallery-inspired design, and the absolute best technology LG makes. InstaView Door-in-Door, Centum System washing (virtually zero vibration), and OLED TV panels built into the fridge door. SIGNATURE exists to prove LG can compete at the highest level.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury buyers who want cutting-edge technology. LG loyalists stepping up to the pinnacle.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for LG SIGNATURE:

• Gallery-inspired design — appliances as art pieces

• Centum System washer has virtually zero vibration — a coin stands on edge during spin

• InstaView with the most advanced door-in-door system LG makes

• OLED technology integration — the future of smart appliances

• Limited distribution creates exclusivity
